title: Director of Product Management

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: Epson's Product Management team owns the SureColor roadmap, application specifications, and technical recommendations that their customers rely on for material compatibility and workflow optimization. This role is essential because they create the technical documentation, application guides, and certification programs that specify which laminates and protective films work optimally with Epson inks and substrates. They would care about Tedlar partnership because: (1) Product quality and customer satisfaction metrics improve when they can recommend a proven protective solution that prevents the UV fading, cracking, and color degradation that leads to warranty claims and customer complaints; (2) Competitive benchmarking shows that complete solutions (printer + ink + protection) win more deals in the premium outdoor graphics segment where municipalities, transit agencies, and fleet operators demand 10-15+ year durability guarantees; (3) Technical collaboration on lamination profiles and application parameters reduces customer trial-and-error, accelerating time-to-production for new SureColor buyers; (4) Product line strategy benefits from validated use cases demonstrating Epson+Tedlar combinations outperforming competitive solutions in harsh outdoor environments. Given Epson's emphasis on same-day lamination capability and immediate scratch resistance in their vehicle wrap and outdoor signage marketing, Product Management needs validated protective film partnerships to substantiate these durability claims with real-world performance data and customer case studies.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: This Director owns the technical roadmap and application specifications for Epson's SureColor product lines (S-Series solvent, R-Series resin, V-Series UV flatbed). They are responsible for creating technical documentation, application guides, and material compatibility recommendations that Epson's customers (sign shops, wrap installers, graphics companies) use to select substrates, inks, and protective films. They likely report to a VP of Product or Commercial Excellence and work cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Technical Support, and Sales Engineering. Their authority includes certifying material partnerships, approving technical specifications for recommended workflows, and defining product positioning based on validated performance data. They influence thousands of purchasing decisions indirectly by determining which materials appear in Epson's official application guides and certification programs.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: Given Epson's emphasis on outdoor signage, vehicle wraps, and architectural graphics, the most relevant Tedlar use cases are: (1) Vehicle wrap overlaminates that maintain color integrity and resist graffiti for fleet graphics printed on SureColor S-Series and R-Series printers—directly supporting Epson's same-day lamination and scratch resistance messaging; (2) Outdoor signage protection for prints on solvent and UV flatbed equipment where municipalities and transit agencies demand 10-15+ year performance guarantees; (3) Architectural graphics and building wraps where UV protection prevents premature fading on large-format installations; (4) Graffiti-resistant overlaminates for transit interiors and public signage where easy cleaning reduces maintenance costs for Epson's end customers. These use cases directly enhance the value proposition of Epson's printer portfolio by solving the durability concerns that prevent customers from winning premium outdoor graphics contracts.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: This role likely owns product adoption rates, customer satisfaction scores, technical support ticket volume related to material compatibility issues, and competitive win rates in the premium outdoor graphics segment. They are personally motivated to reduce warranty claims and customer complaints stemming from print degradation, UV fading, and premature failure—issues that damage Epson's reputation even when caused by incompatible protective films chosen by customers. They care about accelerating time-to-production for new SureColor buyers by providing validated workflows that eliminate trial-and-error. Their performance is measured by how effectively their technical recommendations translate into customer success stories, repeat purchases, and competitive differentiation against Roland, HP, and Mimaki. A validated Tedlar partnership provides concrete evidence to substantiate Epson's durability claims and reduces the technical risk for customers bidding on long-term outdoor contracts.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: Epson maintains highly active presence at ISA Sign Expo (2024, 2025, 2026) and PRINTING United (2024, 2025), where they showcase new SureColor models and win industry awards. They recently launched the SureColor S9170 solvent printer at PRINTING United 2024 and announced multiple new models at ISA 2024 and 2025. This continuous product launch cycle creates immediate need for updated application guides and material compatibility documentation. Epson's #1 market position in dye-sublimation and UV flatbed printing means Product Management is under pressure to maintain leadership through ecosystem partnerships that solve complete customer workflows. With ISA Sign Expo 2026 approaching and ongoing competitive pressure from Roland and HP, now is an ideal time to propose technical collaboration on lamination profiles and joint durability case studies that can be showcased at upcoming trade shows.

personalization_hooks.hook: Epson's SureColor marketing emphasizes same-day lamination and immediate scratch resistance for vehicle wraps, but lacks a validated protective film recommendation to substantiate these durability claims
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Position Tedlar as the technical partner that turns Epson's durability messaging into proven performance data—offer to collaborate on lamination profile development and application guides that help SureColor customers achieve the 10-15+ year outdoor lifespan their end customers demand

personalization_hooks.hook: Recent SureColor S9170 launch and continuous new model announcements at ISA and PRINTING United create immediate need for updated technical documentation and material compatibility guides
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Reference the S9170 launch specifically and propose a joint technical validation project that Product Management can showcase at ISA Sign Expo 2026—frame this as a competitive advantage opportunity to differentiate Epson's complete solution story against Roland and HP

personalization_hooks.hook: Epson's target customers (municipalities, transit agencies, fleet operators) increasingly demand 10-15+ year performance guarantees for outdoor graphics, but standard laminates fail to meet these requirements
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Lead with the warranty and performance guarantee challenge—explain how Tedlar's proven track record enables Epson's customers to confidently bid on premium contracts they currently walk away from due to durability concerns, directly increasing SureColor utilization in high-value outdoor segments

recommended_approach: Lead with the technical partnership angle rather than a sales pitch. Position the outreach as a collaboration opportunity to solve Epson customers' durability challenges through validated workflows and application guides. Reference the recent S9170 launch and upcoming ISA presence to demonstrate awareness of their product roadmap. Offer specific value (lamination profiles, compatibility testing, joint case studies) that Product Management can use immediately to enhance their technical documentation and competitive positioning. Avoid generic durability language—focus on concrete outcomes like reducing warranty claims, enabling customers to win municipal contracts, and accelerating time-to-production for new SureColor buyers.
